cards.ex: Despite the rise of online businesses, many investors still prefer bricks and mortar.
cards.exUz: Onlayn biznes rivojlanishiga qaramay, ko'plab investorlar hali ham ko'chmas mulkni afzal ko'rishadi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'chmas mulk, bino va inshootlar. Ko'pincha biznesning jismoniy aktivlari haqida gapirilganda ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: It's so hard for young people to get on the property ladder these days.
cards.exUz: Yoshlar uchun hozirgi kunda ko'chmas mulk sotib olish juda qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Ko'chmas mulk sotib olish yo'lini boshlash, ayniqsa birinchi marta.

cards.ex: After years of renting, she finally has a place of her own.
cards.exUz: Uzoq yillar ijara uylarda yashagandan so'ng, nihoyat uning o'z uyi bor.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy mulk bo'lgan uy yoki kvartira.

cards.ex: Experts are worried about a potential real estate bubble forming in major cities.
cards.exUz: Mutaxassislar yirik shaharlarda ko'chmas mulk pufagi paydo bo'lishidan xavotirda.
cards.uzDef: Ko'chmas mulk narxlarining asossiz ravishda tez o'sishi.

cards.ex: They're house poor; they own a big house but can't afford to go on vacation.
cards.exUz: Ular 'uyga qaram', katta uy egalari, lekin ta'tilga chiqishga puli yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Uy sotib olgandan so'ng, boshqa narsalarga puli yetmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: The mortgage rate has been fluctuating a lot lately.
cards.exUz: Ipoteka foiz stavkasi oxirgi paytlarda juda o'zgarib turibdi.
cards.uzDef: Ipoteka krediti bo'yicha to'lanadigan foiz stavkasi.

cards.ex: The property developer is planning to build a new shopping mall.
cards.exUz: Qurilish kompaniyasi yangi savdo markazini qurishni rejalashtirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yerlarni sotib oladigan va binolar quradigan kompaniya yoki shaxs.

cards.ex: It's important to know your tenant rights before signing a lease.
cards.exUz: Ijara shartnomasini imzolashdan oldin ijarachining huquqlarini bilish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Ijarachining qonuniy huquqlari, masalan, uyning ta'mirlanishi.

cards.ex: Remember, when buying property, it's all about location, location, location!
cards.exUz: Unutmang, mulk sotib olayotganda, eng muhimi joylashuv, joylashuv, joylashuv!
cards.uzDef: Ko'chmas mulkning eng muhim jihati uning joylashuvi ekanligini ta'kidlash.

cards.ex: Buy-to-let investments can be a good source of passive income.
cards.exUz: Ijaraga sotib olish sarmoyalari passiv daromadning yaxshi manbai bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ijaraga berish maqsadida mulk sotib olish.

cards.ex: She has built up an impressive property portfolio over the years.
cards.exUz: U yillar davomida ta'sirchan mulkiy portfelni shakllantirdi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxs yoki kompaniyaning egaligidagi ko'chmas mulklar to'plami.

cards.ex: The city is facing a severe housing shortage.
cards.exUz: Shahar jiddiy uy-joy tanqisligiga duch kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud uy-joylar sonining ehtiyojdan kamligi.

cards.ex: The rental yield on that apartment is quite high.
cards.exUz: Ushbu kvartiraning ijara daromadi juda yuqori.
cards.uzDef: Ijaradan olinadigan daromadning mulk qiymatiga nisbati.

cards.ex: The offer is subject to contract.
cards.exUz: Taklif shartnoma asosida qabul qilinadi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishuv hali rasmiy emas va shartnoma imzolanishi kerakligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: They decided to move in the suburbs for a quieter life.
cards.exUz: Ular tinch hayot kechirish uchun shahar chetiga ko'chib o'tishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning tashqarisidagi aholi yashaydigan hududlarda.

cards.ex: The new factory is located on the outskirts of the city.
cards.exUz: Yangi fabrika shahar chetida joylashgan.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning eng chekka qismida, undan tashqarida.

cards.ex: The city skyline is dominated by high-rise buildings.
cards.exUz: Shahar manzarasida ko'p qavatli binolar ustunlik qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda baland bino, odatda ko'p qavatli uy yoki ofis.

cards.ex: It's hard to get your foot in the door of the property market.
cards.exUz: Ko'chmas mulk bozorida imkoniyatga ega bo'lish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Biror sohada muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun birinchi qadamni qo'yish.

cards.ex: She's hoping to use her nest egg to buy a small cottage by the sea.
cards.exUz: U o'zining jamg'armasidan dengiz bo'yida kichik kottej sotib olishga umid qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kelajak uchun saqlangan pul, odatda pensiya uchun.

cards.ex: A mortgage broker can help you find the best deal.
cards.exUz: Ipoteka brokeri sizga eng yaxshi shartnomani topishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Turli banklardan ipoteka kreditlarini topishda yordam beradigan mutaxassis.

cards.ex: They have a lot of equity in their home.
cards.exUz: Ularning uyida katta kapital bor.
cards.uzDef: Mulkning qarzdan keyingi qiymati.

cards.ex: The housing bubble burst in 2008.
cards.exUz: Uy-joy pufagi 2008 yilda portladi.
cards.uzDef: Uy-joy narxlarining asossiz ravishda tez o'sishi.

cards.ex: The city is experiencing a property boom.
cards.exUz: Shaharda ko'chmas mulk narxlari tez o'smoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ko'chmas mulk narxlarining tez va sezilarli o'sishi.

cards.ex: After the kids moved out, they decided to downsize.
cards.exUz: Bolalar ketgandan so'ng, ular uyni kichraytirishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kattaroq uydan kichikroq uyga ko'chish.

cards.ex: They upsized when they had their third child.
cards.exUz: Uchinchi farzand tug'ilganda, ular uyni kattalashtirishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kichikroq uydan kattaroq uyga ko'chish.

cards.ex: The commute to the city center is quite long.
cards.exUz: Shahar markaziga qaynab yurish ancha uzoq.
cards.uzDef: Uyidan ishiga va aksincha muntazam ravishda borib kelish.

cards.ex: Housing affordability is a major issue in many cities.
cards.exUz: Uy-joy narxi ko'plab shaharlarda asosiy muammo hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Aholi uy-joy sotib olish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: We use a property management company to handle our rentals.
cards.exUz: Biz ijaraga berilgan uylarimizni boshqarish uchun mulkni boshqarish kompaniyasidan foydalanamiz.
cards.uzDef: Ijaraga berilgan mulkni boshqarish xizmati.

cards.ex: The country is facing a severe housing crisis.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat jiddiy uy-joy inqiroziga duch kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Uy-joy narxlarining keskin oshishi yoki uy-joy yetishmasligi bilan bog'liq muammo.

cards.ex: This is a great starter home for a young couple.
cards.exUz: Bu yosh oila uchun ajoyib boshlang'ich uy.
cards.uzDef: Birinchi marta uy sotib olayotganlar uchun mo'ljallangan uy.
